summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to be held on April 30, 2026. Proposals include increasing authorized share capital by adding 349.5M class B ordinary shares (from 500,000 to 350M) and amending the memorandum of association to reflect the increase, followed by a share capital reduction and reorganization. The record date is April 6, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; this is a routine capital structure adjustment requiring shareholder approval. No deal terms apply.
